static_ready.note: STATIC_READY certifies suitability as a provenance-clean static centerline seed. It is not DYNAMICS_READY and is not a particle/SST claim.

provider_agreement.orientation_rule: Wr_abs is used for shape agreement. Signed Wr is retained separately to expose orientation/chirality changes.
provider_agreement.threshold_note: These bands are transparent analysis-policy tolerances, not physical constants and not fitted to SST predictions.
provider_agreement.provider_weighting_rule: Each provider contributes one median per observable. Within-provider variant spread is retained separately; a provider with many variants never gets extra votes.
provider_agreement.anchor_rule: Provider anchors are convenience seeds selected only by provenance/source-stage/capability completeness/resolution/stable ID; anchors do not determine provider agreement.

topology_static_status.CROSS_PROVIDER_ROBUST: At least two independent primary providers, all required agreement observables resolved for >=2 providers, and all inside acceptable policy bands.
topology_static_status.CROSS_PROVIDER_SENSITIVE: At least two independent primary providers but one or more required observables exceed the acceptable policy band.
topology_static_status.CROSS_PROVIDER_INCOMPLETE: At least two independent primary providers but one or more required agreement observables lack >=2 resolved values.
topology_static_status.SINGLE_PROVIDER_QUALIFIED: Exactly one independent primary STATIC_READY provider; usable for static falsifiers with an explicit single-provider limitation.
topology_static_status.STATIC_NOT_READY_NO_UPSTREAM_REFERENCE: No independent upstream primary seed passes the STATIC_READY core gate.
topology_static_status.STATIC_NOT_READY_E010_EXCLUDED: No carrier survived the authoritative E010 carrier-level admission for this selected topology.
topology_static_status.STATIC_NOT_READY_CORE_OBSERVABLES: An independent upstream carrier exists but its v0.3.0 static core observables are not all RESOLVED.
topology_static_status.STATIC_NOT_READY_MIRROR_ONLY: Only a mirror/provenance fallback remains; mirrors can never become STATIC_READY.
